references.text: Taberah is mentioned here as the place where the Lord's fire burned among the people because of their complaints, the same event referred to in Deuteronomy 9:22.
Massah is mentioned here as the place where the people put the Lord to the test by demanding water, the same place referred to in Deuteronomy 9:22.
Kibroth-hattaavah (graves of craving) is mentioned here as the place where the people who had craved meat were buried, the same place referred to in Deuteronomy 9:22.
Kibroth-hattaavah is listed among Israel's campgrounds in the wilderness, the same place mentioned in Deuteronomy 9:22.
Massah is mentioned as a warning not to put the Lord to the test as the people did there, related to the event in Deuteronomy 9:22.
Massah is mentioned in Moses' blessing over the tribe of Levi, with reference to the testing that took place there.
